description: List hosted audio posts for the acting actor, or replies addressed to a given thread-root author. Tenancy-scoped and cursor-paginated.

main.description: Returns a cursor-paginated page of hosted posts in the caller's tenancy. By default lists the acting actor's own posts, optionally filtered by `kind`. When `rootAuthor` is set, lists replies addressed to that thread-root author instead (ignoring `kind`).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the `cursor` from the previous page (the last post id).

kind.description: Restrict to prompts or replies (ignored when `rootAuthor` is set).

rootAuthor.description: Return replies addressed to this thread-root author instead of the acting actor's own posts.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.
